sloka: मया रामस्य पश्येमां कोपेन च निषूदिताम्।एषा विशस्ता वैदेही विफलो वः परिश्रमः ।। ६.८१.३३ ।।
transliteration: mayā rāmasya paśyemāṁ kopena ca niṣūditām।eṣā viśastā vaidehī viphalo vaḥ pariśramaḥ ।। 6.81.33 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith himself with his long sword killed her, then rejoiced, he ascended the chariot and roared in a loud tone.
